items.title: Brazil: Flavio Bolsonaro faces corruption probe weeks before election
items.summary: Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, Lula's top rival in next month's election, is under investigation for alleged corruption linked to financing a biopic about his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro.
